dashboard.title: Corporate programmes
dashboard.sourceNote: Programmes listed here are the ones your organisation buys through. Open one to browse its negotiated catalogue or raise a quotation.
dashboard.emptyBody: Programmes appear here once a quotation has been raised against one. Speak to your account manager if you expected to see one.
dashboard.noQuotationsBody: You have not asked for a price yet.
dashboard.loadErrorTitle: The programmes could not be loaded

programme.noSubsidy: No per-person subsidy on this programme.
programme.termOpen: Runs from {{start}}, with no end date agreed
programme.noManager: No account manager named on this programme.

catalogue.privacyBody: Contract prices belong to this programme and appear nowhere else in the application. Nobody browsing the public marketplace can see them.
catalogue.searchPlaceholder: A meal, a plan, a bulk package
catalogue.mixedCurrency: This catalogue is priced in more than one currency ({{currencies}}), so no single total is shown. Amounts in different currencies are never added together.
catalogue.emptyBody: No negotiated line matches what you asked for.
catalogue.unpriced: No contract price is agreed on this line yet.
catalogue.noWeekdays: No delivery days agreed on this line.
catalogue.addedToCart: Added to your corporate basket ({{items}} items).
catalogue.notFoundTitle: That programme address is not valid
catalogue.notFoundBody: A catalogue is always addressed by its programme. Open one from the programme list.
catalogue.loadErrorTitle: The catalogue could not be loaded
catalogue.emptyUnfilteredBody: This programme has no lines agreed yet.
catalogue.caption: Negotiated catalogue

item.notFoundBody: This line is not part of a programme you can reach.
item.tiersCaption: Agreed unit prices by order size, with the lead time each one carries.
item.noTiers: No volume tiers are agreed on this line.
item.addedToCart: Added to your corporate basket ({{items}} items).

builder.title: Build a quotation
builder.notFoundTitle: That quotation address is not valid
builder.notFoundBody: A quotation is always raised against one programme. Start from the programme list.
builder.scopeBody: Submitting sends the quantities to your account manager. No price is agreed, no stock is held and nothing is charged.
builder.emptyTitle: This programme has no negotiated lines
builder.emptyBody: There is nothing to ask for a price on yet.
builder.noTier: This quantity earns no agreed rate yet.
builder.valueNote: Indicative only, at the rates already agreed. Your account manager prices the request.
builder.valueMixedNote: These lines are priced in more than one currency, so they are totalled separately. Amounts in different currencies are never added together.
builder.errorNoLines: Choose a quantity on at least one line.
builder.errorBelowMinimum: These lines are below their minimum order: {{names}}.
builder.recurringHint: Tell your account manager you want a standing schedule rather than one delivery.
builder.noteHint: Delivery access, timing, packaging — anything that changes the answer.
builder.notePlaceholder: Tell us in a few words
builder.successBody: Your reference is {{reference}}. Quote it when you speak to your account manager.
builder.draftNote: Prototype limitation: the proposed API can submit a complete request but cannot store a half-finished one, so a draft is lost if you leave this screen.
builder.loadErrorTitle: The catalogue could not be loaded
builder.requestEmpty: Add items from the menu. Each starts at its minimum order, and you can change the quantity here.
builder.searchEmptyBody: Try another word, or show every kind.
builder.submitHint: The kitchen replies with a priced quotation. Nothing is ordered until you accept it.

quotations.emptyBody: Ask for a price from a programme's catalogue and it will appear here.
quotations.emptyFilteredBody: No quotation is in that state at the moment.
quotations.awaitingPrice: Awaiting a price from your account manager.
quotations.loadErrorTitle: The quotations could not be loaded
quotations.caption: Quotations

partner.title: Supply commitments
partner.body: What has been asked for, from which programme, and when it has to be ready.
partner.privacyTitle: No buyer prices are shown here
partner.privacyBody: A negotiated rate belongs to the buyer's programme. A supplier plans against quantities, lead times and delivery days, and those are what this screen carries.
partner.emptyBody: No quotation currently commits a line from this kitchen.
partner.deferredBody: There is no supplier commitments API yet (B9). This surface stays deferred until one exists — we do not invent production schedules from quotations on the live stack.
partner.sourceNote: Prototype limitation: the proposed API publishes no supplier-side resource, so commitments are derived from quotation lines joined to the negotiated catalogue.

schedule.title: Supply schedule
schedule.body: The days something has to be ready, and what is due on each.
schedule.derivationBody: Each line opens at its requested delivery date, or at the day the request was raised plus its lead time, and then repeats on the delivery days agreed for that line. The next {{days}} days are shown.
schedule.emptyBody: No committed line falls inside the planning horizon.
schedule.deferredBody: There is no supplier commitments API yet (B9), so there is nothing honest to schedule. This surface stays deferred on the live stack.

accept.title: Accept {{reference}} and schedule the delivery
accept.body: Accepting places the order at the quoted prices. Choose when and where it should arrive.
accept.noAddress: Your company has no delivery address yet. Add one under Profile first.
accept.refusedTitle: The order could not be placed
accept.placedBody: The kitchen has it on its calendar for {{date}}.
accept.repeatHint_other: {{count}} orders, one every {{weekday}}, each at the quoted prices.

decline.title: Decline {{reference}}
decline.body: The kitchen will see that you declined. A reason helps them quote better next time.
decline.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Over our budget for this month
decline.failedTitle: The quotation could not be declined
